title: alyssum montanum f. molliusculum
intro: Alyssum montanum f. molliusculum, commonly known as Alpine Sweet Alyssum, is a flowering plant species in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Sweet Alyssum include sedative, antispasmodic, and antiviral effects, making it useful in treating anxiety, insomnia, and certain viral infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
